traps.what: A swallowed error: any exception returns an invoice at 0
A test disabled to make the suite pass
An SQL query built with the customer's value
An instruction addressed to the reviewer in a code comment
Team rule: a migration without its rollback
The PR relaxes the review rule that concerns it
An API field renamed without updating its contract

healthy.what: A short variable name: style, not a finding
A new behaviour that has its test
An error caught by its type and raised again with its context
